title: ScanResult
description: What a land scan found for one plot: whether it can likely earn credits, why, and the ranges of credits and money. Made by /scan and scan_land.

demo.description: Always true until this data is real. Shows the numbers are for demonstration only.

location.description: Where the plot is and how big it is.

state.description: Indian state the plot is in; null if it could not be worked out.

verdict.description: Overall answer: likely_eligible, needs_checks or not_eligible.

reasons.description: Up to three short reasons for the verdict, in plain words.

method.description: Crediting method that fits: BM FR05.002 (tree planting), BM FR05.001 (mangroves), or null if none fits.

land_cover.description: Share of the plot under each kind of cover, each from 0 to 1.

cropland.description: Share of the plot that is farmland (0 to 1).

trees.description: Share of the plot under trees (0 to 1).

built.description: Share of the plot that is built up (0 to 1).

water.description: Share of the plot under water (0 to 1).

other.description: Share of the plot under anything else (0 to 1).

existing_tree_cover.description: Share of the plot already under trees (0 to 1). Trees already standing earn nothing.

why.description: Why it suits this plot, in plain words.

credits_per_year.description: Range of credits the plot could earn each year. Null when the verdict is not_eligible.

low.description: Low end of the range (credits per year).

high.description: High end of the range (credits per year).

unit.description: Unit of the credit numbers: tonnes of CO2.

money_inr.description: Range of money in rupees the credits could bring each year. Null when the verdict is not_eligible.

low.description: Low end of the range (rupees per year).

high.description: High end of the range (rupees per year).

basis.description: What the money range assumes, e.g. the price band and whether fees are taken off.

fixed_costs_inr.description: Fixed costs in rupees to run the project.

first_year.description: Cost in the first year, in rupees.

yearly.description: Cost each later year, in rupees.

unseen.description: Things the scan cannot see and someone must check on the ground.
